reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to USD 65 million with a tenor of up to 7 years (the "Loan") to Polat Enerji Yatirimlari A.S. (the "Borrower" or the "Company"), a renewable energy company operating in Turkiye. The Project is also expected to benefit from concessional financing from the AIRE Program in the amount of USD 5.0 million, subject to donor's approval. The proceeds of the Loan will be used for the development and construction of (i) 30.8MW wind capacity expansion at the Borrower's operating WPP portfolio (i.e. Soma WPP, Geycek WPP and Poyraz WPP), (ii) a 46.6MW solar plant (which will be developed under hybrid power plant regulation) co-located with the operating Geycek WPP, and (iii) a battery storage project with an installed capacity of 10.0MWh also co-located with the Geycek WPP (the "Project").
